rules: draggable objects emit position changes continuously during pointer movement
generic drag interaction can move objects horizontally or vertically
3D picking uses the object position rather than a fixed floor-plane projection
consumers can invalidate dependent calculations on every position change
reactive views recompute at most once per animation frame
pointer release is not required before a dependent visualization updates
preview resolution may be reduced during interaction if full-quality output is restored after interaction
drag behavior is implemented generically in core and domain objects opt in through instances
TransformGizmoController is a generic core interaction and contains no application or domain semantics
transform gizmos have an explicit global enabled state and perform no selection or transformation while disabled
clicking an unselected gizmo candidate selects it in position mode
clicking the already selected candidate without dragging toggles position and rotate modes
position and rotation may be adapted by candidate-provided gizmo getter and setter hooks
SceneObject rotation is explicit transform state and rotated Box primitives must render that state
domains may constrain transforms through adapters rather than duplicating the transform controller
